Is Lamai good for nightlife? | Yes for a relaxed night out, no for clubbing. Shamrock Irish Pub has a show band nightly from about 21:30 to 01:30, Rock Bar plays reggae and rock by the Hin Ta and Hin Yai rocks, and Teddy Weed runs beach fire shows until about 02:00. For clubs, Chaweng is 20–25 minutes north.
Where is the live music in Lamai? | Shamrock Irish Pub on Lamai Beach Road has a resident band every night from about 21:30 to 01:30. Rock Bar at the southern tip of the bay hosts reggae and rock bands, and the bar inside Lamai Night Market has live music among the food stalls in the evening.
Can I still party at Beach Republic in Lamai? | Not really. The pool bar and much of the resort at the south end of Lamai were reported closed in 2025–26, leaving a beach café open about 08:00–21:00. Its Sunday brunch and pool parties are no longer advertised, so don't plan a night around it.
How far is Chaweng from Lamai at night? | About 12 km, or 20–25 minutes by car along the coast road. Songthaews mostly stop by 22:00, so at night use Grab (roughly 250–400 THB, more in rain or after 02:00) or a taxi with the fare agreed first. Don't ride a scooter over the dark Lad Koh headland after drinking.
Is Lamai quieter than Chaweng? | Yes. Lamai has pubs, beach bars and a beer-bar quarter but no big clubs, and most bars wind down between 01:00 and 02:00. Chaweng's clubs on Soi Green Mango run until about 04:00. Lamai suits couples, older travellers and anyone who wants a night out within walking distance of a quieter bed.
Are there Muay Thai fights in Lamai? | We could not confirm a current 2026 fight schedule in Lamai; an undated listing mentions Saturday-night bouts at a ring in the centre. The reliable fight nights are in Chaweng: Phetchbuncha on Monday, Wednesday and Saturday, and Samui International on Tuesday, Friday and Sunday, both from about 21:00.
What does a beer cost in Lamai? | About 80–120 THB in most bars, 130–220 THB at Shamrock and 180–300 THB for a cocktail at a beach bar in 2026, noticeably cheaper than central Chaweng. A market dinner costs 100–250 THB per person.
Where can I eat late in Lamai? | The Lamai Seafood Market in the centre, near McDonald's, runs daily until about midnight, and Lamai Night Market before the river bridge opens from about 17:00. After midnight it is 7-Eleven, though shops can't sell alcohol after 24:00.
